Forming part of Ballaskyr Estate, the property benefits from a private terrace, rear garden, integral garage and two parking spaces. The apartment forms part of Ballaskyr Estate, an established working rural farm, and enjoys a peaceful countryside setting with attractive views over the surrounding landscape. The spacious sitting room enjoys pleasant countryside views and features sliding doors opening directly onto a private terrace, creating an ideal space for relaxing and enjoying the rural surroundings. The open plan kitchen and dining area provides generous space for everyday living and entertaining, with convenient internal access into the integral garage. A separate utility room and WC offer additional practicality. There are three well proportioned bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, together with a family bathroom serving the remaining bedrooms.
